milestone: Tensor arithmetic within resident GPU matrix graphs
implementation: Bounded graph proof tracks matrix and tensor arithmetic stages through named/imported helpers, scalar lifting, shared intermediates and a single optional final reduction
Each arithmetic shader loads one or two distinct resident tensor operands; scalar typed SSA reuses existing strict float32 lowering and preserves original operand order
One task preflights graph shapes, residence and kernel interfaces, selects the next matrix/map stage after acknowledgement and releases retained operands after their last use
Map kernel tables, immutable capture packs and metadata use the argument budget; source expansion has an aggregate graph shader work bound; empty stages remain iterative

qualification.reference: Checked CPU project helper, separate GPU matmul/map calls, and LLVM APFloat with separately rounded products, adjacent-pair contraction trees and per-operation float32 rounding; NaNs compared by classification
cases: Maps between two products; imported/private helpers and re-exports; scalar lifting; tensor negation and IEEE division by zero
Scalar-left division and reversed tensor subtraction versus compact physical binding order
Maps before the first product and after the last, composed with final reduceSum/scalar arithmetic; shared product branches joined by subtraction
Zero output/contraction extents, odd trees, finite values, subnormals, signed zeros, infinities, quiet/signaling NaNs, cancellation-sensitive values and arbitrary encodings across 1/2/4 workers
Copied submission tensor/edge/kernel/scalar arrays; cached and independently retained outcomes after group release
56 allocation checkpoints, cancellation/deadline/device failure at all five command stages, pending core destruction, invalid stage kernel/arity and late shape mismatch before dispatch
2048 alternating empty matrix/map stages without recursive stack growth; transactional rejection of unused stages, branches and a 400-map graph exceeding aggregate shader expansion work
qualification.packaging: Installed Release compiler builds the mixed arithmetic graph; relocated executable and all three map shader libraries run after compiler resources are removed

remaining: Multiple reductions and scalar joins within one graph
Broader GPU numeric types, ranks and device control flow
Adjacent arithmetic stage fusion and command/storage optimization
